purpose: Deterministic bidirectional navigation between canonical Parallel Quest records and canonical Super Soul records where the Super Soul layer has an exact PQ acquisition source.
source_policy: Only exact canonical acquisition_source mappings are linked. No relationship is inferred from character appearance, quest theme, or generic reward lists without an exact named Super Soul match.
notes: The 13 linked Super Souls are exactly the records whose canonical acquisition_type is Parallel Quest in the current 50-record Super Soul layer.
PQ58 and PQ131 were synchronized with explicit super_soul_ids and super_soul_rewards in the canonical PQ layer during this cycle.
The relationship layer does not claim exact drop percentages beyond the source-backed 50% rolls recorded on Super Soul 049 and 055.
